```{r}
mono_feature_plot_umap_defense <- function(feature_select,title=NA, subtitle=""){
    if (is.na(title)) {title <- feature_select
  }
  plot_ <- mono |>
  join_features(features = ensemblizer_2(feature_select)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(UMAP_1,UMAP_2,color=.abundance_RNA)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.5, shape=16)+
  scale_color_viridis_c(values = c(0, 0.30, 0.35, 0.5,1)
                        )+
  #scale_fill_viridis_c()+
  ggtitle(title,
          subtitle = subtitle)+
  coord_fixed()+ggdark::dark_theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  family = "Calibri", size=18),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                     family = "Calibri", size=11),
        title = element_text(family = "Calibri"),
        text = element_text(family = "Calibri"),
        axis.title = element_text(size=12))+
  xlab("UMAP 1")+
  ylab("UMAP 2")+
  labs(color=feature_select)
  return(plot_)
}

mono_feature_plot_umap_defense_meta_data_pc <- function(feature_select, title=NA, subtitle=""){
  if (is.na(title)) {title <- feature_select
  }
  
  plot_ <- mono |>
  select(feature_select, UMAP_1, UMAP_2) |> 
  ggplot(aes_string("UMAP_1","UMAP_2",color=feature_select)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.5, shape=16)+
  scale_color_viridis_c(values = c(0, 0.30, 0.7, 0.9,1)
                        )+
  #scale_fill_viridis_c()+
  ggtitle(title,
          subtitle = subtitle)+
  coord_fixed()+ggdark::dark_theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  family = "Calibri", size=18),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                     family = "Calibri", size=11),
        title = element_text(family = "Calibri"),
        text = element_text(family = "Calibri"),
        axis.title = element_text(size=12))+
  xlab("UMAP 1")+
  ylab("UMAP 2")+
  labs(color=feature_select)
  return(plot_)
}
```

```{r}
mono_meta_data_boxplot <- function(feature_select, title=NA, subtitle=""){
  if (is.na(title)) {title <- feature_select
  }
  
  plot_ <- mono |> 
  
  ggplot(aes_string("condition",feature_select)) +
  geom_jitter(size=0.3,alpha=0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = F) +
  #scale_fill_viridis_c()+
  ggtitle(title,
          subtitle = subtitle)+
  ggdark::dark_theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  family = "Calibri", size=18),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                     family = "Calibri", size=11),
        title = element_text(family = "Calibri"),
        text = element_text(family = "Calibri"),
        axis.title = element_text(size=12),
        axis.text = element_text(size=12, face = "bold")
        )
  return(plot_)
}


```

```{r}

mono_meta_data_boxplot_2 <- function(feature_select,feature_group, title=NA, subtitle="", y_label=""){
  if (is.na(title)) {title <- feature_select
  }
  
  plot_ <- mono |> 
  
  ggplot(aes_string("condition",feature_select, color=feature_group)) +
  geom_jitter(size=0.3,alpha=0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = F) +
  #scale_fill_viridis_c()+
  ggtitle(title,
          subtitle = subtitle)+
  ggdark::dark_theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  family = "Calibri", size=18),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                     family = "Calibri", size=11),
        title = element_text(family = "Calibri"),
        text = element_text(family = "Calibri"),
        axis.title = element_text(size=12),
        axis.text = element_text(size=12, face = "bold")
        )+
    ylab(y_label)
  return(plot_)
}

```

```{r}
mono_fib_geneset_ensg <- genesets_fibrosis %>% lapply(function(x) ensemblizer_seur(x)) %>% 
  lapply(function(x) genifiy_seur(x)) %>% 
  lapply(function(x) ensemblizer_seur(x)) %>% 
  lapply(function(x) na.omit(x))  
  

mono_genset_select <- mono_fib_geneset_ensg[c(3,7,2,11,13,14)]

mono <- add_named_module_score( 
  seurat_object   = mono ,
  genesets_list_named = mono_genset_select,
  score_id = "score_fibrosis",
  nbin_ = 8
)
```
